title: AT&T Stadium named most haunted sports stadium in North America
excerpt: A recent survey named AT&T Stadium as the most haunted stadium in North America, and it's not just because of the lack of Cowboys playoff success.
content:
Published October 30, 2026 7:38 AM CDT

ARLINGTON, Texas - A recent survey named AT&T Stadium as the most haunted stadium in North America, and it's not just because of the lack of Cowboys playoff success. 

What we know:

Sports Geek released the ranking based on a review of the folklore, graveyard proximity, and construction history of each venue.

AT&T Stadium topped the ranking with a score of 62 out of 100. The 17-year-old venue received the maximum points for published ghost stories. 

The stadium also sits near Keystone Cemetery, which is attributed to its score. 

Staff members described mysterious shadows, unexplained voices, and approaching footsteps that suddenly stop. 

In one stadium kitchen, employees witnessed dishes rising into the air before crashing to the floor. This incident frightened some workers enough to quit on the spot, according to the report.

Workers also reported an unexplained cold spot near a room named after legendary Cowboys coach Tom Landry, fueling speculation that his spirit remains at the stadium.

By the numbers:

Sports Geek reviewed 47 professional sports venues across the United States and Canada. Each venue received a score out of 100 across seven weighted categories:

  • Published ghost stories and documentation: 30 points
  • Stadium age: 15 points
  • Proximity to burial sites: 15 points
  • Reviewed Reddit discussions about hauntings: 10 points
  • Paranormal investigations or tours: 10 points
  • Verified tragedies or historical events: 10 points
  • Named or recurring ghosts: 10 points

The Source: The information in this article comes from a Sports Geek press release and ranking report.
